ground_truth.description: Minimum reward-per-hour validation occurs before protocol fees are deducted. Check validates gross amount, then fees subtracted, reducing actual distribution below required minimum.
ground_truth.root_cause: Minimum reward-per-hour validation occurs before protocol fees are deducted. Check validates gross amount, then fees subtracted, reducing actual distribution below required minimum.
ground_truth.fix_description: Move minimum rate validation to occur after fee computation, validating against net amount.

prediction.overall_explanation: The contract implements a well-designed reward distribution system with proper security measures. Key security features include: ReentrancyGuard for preventing reentrancy attacks during fund transfers; proper access controls with modifiers restricting sensitive functions to governors/guardians; input validation for campaign parameters like duration and reward amounts; safe ERC20 transfers using OpenZeppelin's SafeERC20 library; and comprehensive fee calculation mechanisms. The contract properly validates campaign uniqueness, handles token transfers securely, and maintains clear separation of duties. No exploitable vulnerabilities were found - all design choices appear intentional and secure within the defined trust model.
